sections.heading: Full Body Checkup Me Kya-Kya Hota Hai — Aur Ye Kis Ke Liye Hai
sections.lead: Pehle soochi, phir wo baat jo naam chhupa leta hai: "full body" me poora sharir nahi aata. Ye screening hai.
blocks: Package me aane wale test aam taur par ye hote hain: khoon ki ginti (CBC), blood sugar aur HbA1c, cholesterol ke liye lipid profile, liver ke liye LFT, kidney ke liye KFT, thyroid, aur urine routine. Bade plan me Vitamin D, Vitamin B12 aur urine microalbumin bhi shaamil ho jaate hain. In sab ke liye sui ek hi baar lagti hai — ek khoon ka sample aur ek urine ka — aur report aam taur par agle din phone par PDF me pahunch jaati hai.

Package ka kaam bimari pakadna nahi hai — un cheezon ko jaldi pakadna hai jo chup chaap badh rahi hoti hain: sugar, cholesterol, thyroid, liver, kidney aur vitamin ki kami. Inme se koi bhi shuruaat me kuch mehsoos nahi karati, aur jab tak mehsoos hoti hai tab tak kai saal nikal chuke hote hain. Isi liye ye un logon ke liye hai jinhe abhi koi shikayat nahi hai.

Ab wo baat jo naam nahi batata. Package ho jaane ke baad “ab sab theek hai” maan lena is jaanch ka sabse bada nuksan hai. Ismein cancer ki jaanch nahi hoti, dil ki bimari ka pakka pata nahi chalta, haddi aur jodon ki jaanch nahi hoti, aur jo cheezein machine par dikhti hain — X-ray, ultrasound, ECG — wo ismein aati hi nahi. Ye teenon machine par hote hain, khoon ke sample par nahi — isliye na wo package me aate hain aur na hamari list me.

Isliye seedha niyam ye hai: koi shikayat pehle se hai to package mat chuniye — doctor ko dikhaiye aur wahi test karaiye jo wo kahe. Package un logon ke liye hai jinhe abhi kuch nahi hai aur jo ek baseline banana chahte hain.

note.title: Screening aur ilaaj alag cheezein hain
note.text: Screening us aadmi ke liye hoti hai jise abhi kuch mehsoos nahi ho raha — uske andar kuch chup-chaap chal raha ho to wo pakda jaye. Shikayat ka jawab dhoondhna iska kaam nahi hai. Isliye agar teen din se bukhar hai, pet me dard hai, ya kai mahine se kamzori lag rahi hai — to package se shuru karna ulta padta hai. Us halat me doctor jo do-teen test likhega, wahi seedha jawab dega, aur wo package se sasta bhi padega.

sections.heading: Chutti Me Ghar Aaye Hain — Teen Din Me Poore Ghar Ka Checkup
sections.lead: Salempur me sabse zyada checkup unhi dinon me hote hain jab bahar kaam karne wale ghar aate hain.
blocks: Yahan ka sabse aam pattern ye hai: ghar ka ek aadmi Delhi, Mumbai, Surat ya Gulf me hai, saal me ek-do baar chutti par aata hai, aur usi chutti me ghar ke bade-bujurgon ka checkup bhi karana hota hai. Chutti chhoti hoti hai, isliye kram galat ho jaye to report haath me aane se pehle wapsi ka din aa jaata hai.
Teen din ka seedha plan ye hai:

list: Pehla din — sabki list ek jagah likh lijiye: kis-kis ka karana hai, kiski umar kya hai, aur kis-kis ki dawa chal rahi hai. Purani report ghar me kahin rakhi ho to wo bhi nikaal lijiye. Booking isi din kar dijiye, agli subah ka pehla slot maang kar.

Doosra din — subah 6 se 8 ke beech ek hi visit me sabka sample. Sabki fasting ek jaisi hogi, isliye raat 9 baje tak sabka khaana ho jaye. Naashta pehle se banwa kar rakhiye — sample ke turant baad sabko dena hai.

Teesra din — report phone par aa jaayegi. Chutti khatam hone se pehle jo sabse zaroori kaam hai wo yahi hai: report ko WhatsApp par ghar ke us aadmi ko bhej dijiye jo yahan rehta hai, aur ek copy apne paas rakhiye. Agla saal jab checkup hoga, tulna isi report se hogi.

blocks: Ek baat jo aksar chhoot jaati hai: bujurgon ka package apne aap alag banta hai. Umar ke saath HbA1c, urine routine aur thyroid teenon ki ahmiyat badh jaati hai, aur ye teenon hi sabse zyada chhoote hain. Ghar ke jawan logon ka package bujurgon par mat lagaiye.
Ek hi visit me poore ghar ka sample kaise liya jaata hai, aur bistar par pade mareez ka kya dhyaan rakha jaata hai — wo poora
me hai.

sections.heading: Package Poora Hai Ya Adhoora — Paanch Line Se Pata Chal Jaata Hai
sections.lead: Package achha ya bura us list se tay hota hai jo usme shaamil hai — us ginti se nahi jo pamphlet par chhapi hai.
blocks: Har jagah package ke saath ek bada number likha rehta hai — 45, 72, 88. Wo number is baat se banta hai ki report par kitni line chhapengi, is baat se nahi ki kitni alag jaanch hui. Ek akela CBC hi 18 se 22 line chhapta hai aur urine routine 10 se 15. Yaani do test mila kar hi "35 parameters" ho gaye. Isliye 88 wala package 45 wale se kamzor nikal sakta hai — agar us 88 me thyroid ya HbA1c hai hi nahi.

sections.heading: Full Body Checkup Ke Liye Khaali Pet Kitne Ghante Rehna Padta Hai
sections.lead: Yahi ek test hai jiske liye poore package ko khaali pet karna padta hai. Wajah samajh lijiye.
blocks: Lipid Profile me cholesterol aur triglyceride ke chaar-paanch number aate hain — Total Cholesterol, LDL, HDL, aur Triglycerides. Ye dil ki bimari ka sabse jaldi milne wala ishaara hai, aur is ilaake me ye ishaara aksar der se pakda jaata hai kyunki koi lakshan hota hi nahi.

list: Isme fasting lagti hai — 10 se 12 ghante. Poora package isi ek test ki wajah se khaali pet hota hai.
Triglycerides khaane par sabse zyada upar-neeche hote hain. Ek din pehle bahut tala-bhuna khaya ho to number badha hua aa sakta hai — isliye ek din pehle aam khana khaiye, na zyada parhez, na daawat.
LDL ko "kharaab" aur HDL ko "achha" kehna aasan hai lekin adhoora hai. Doctor teenon ko saath me dekhta hai, aur sugar aur BP ke saath milakar dekhta hai.
Ek din pehle sharaab bilkul nahi — triglycerides is par seedha upar chale jaate hain, aur phir report ka matlab hi nikalna mushkil ho jaata hai.
Sugar ki dawa chal rahi ho to lipid saal me ek baar zaroor karaiye. Follow-up me sabse zyada yahi test chhoota hai, kyunki isme koi takleef nahi hoti.

sections.lead: Package ek hi sample me ho jaata hai, lekin us ek sample ki taiyaari maayne rakhti hai.
blocks: Package ki booking me sabse zyada gadbad slot aur fasting par hoti hai. Chaar cheezein pehle se tay kar lijiye, phir visit bilkul seedhi rehti hai.

list: Slot — subah 6 se 8 ka pehla slot. Package hamesha khaali pet hota hai, aur der ke slot ka matlab lambi bhookh hai.
Raat ka khana — 9 baje tak. Isse 10 se 12 ghante apne aap poore ho jaate hain. Beech me sirf saada paani; chai, doodh, biscuit ya paan fasting tod dete hain.
Naashta — pehle se taiyaar rakhiye. Sample ke turant baad kha sakte hain, aur bujurgon aur bachchon ke liye ye zaroori hai.
Dawa aur haalat — jo dawa chal rahi hai, aur pregnancy, khoon patla karne wali dawa, ya nas ki purani dikkat — ye sab booking ke waqt bata dijiye. Niyamit dawa apne aap band mat kijiye.

blocks: Ek baat aur, jo aksar poochhi jaati hai: periods ke dinon me package karana theek hai ya nahi. Blood ke test par iska koi khaas asar nahi padta, lekin urine ka sample us waqt saaf nahi aata. Isliye package me urine routine hai to do-teen din baad ka slot lijiye — aur agar rukna theek nahi lagta to booking ke waqt bata dijiye.
Ghar ke kai log kara rahe hain to sabka slot ek hi rakhiye — ek hi visit me sabka sample ho jaata hai. Jinke test me fasting nahi lagti, unhe bhookha rakhne ki zaroorat nahi.

faqs.question: Salempur me full body checkup ka daam kitna hota hai?
faqs.answer: Daam package ki soochi se tay hota hai, uske parameter number se nahi. Thyroid, HbA1c, Vitamin D aur B12 alag reagent aur alag machine maangte hain, isliye jis plan me ye shaamil hain wo upar padta hai — aur us badhe hue daam ke badle sach me zyada jaankari milti hai. Jo plan inke bina sasta lagta hai, wo isliye sasta hai ki usme kam hai; kam daam me zyada nahi mil raha hota. Ghar se sample lene par koi visiting ya travel charge upar se nahi jodha jaata. Aaj ka rate Salempur ki rate list par har plan ke saamne likha rehta hai, aur booking wali call par poora amount sui lagne se pehle bata diya jaata hai.

faqs.question: Full body checkup ke liye khaali pet rehna zaroori hai?
faqs.answer: Haan, zyadatar package fasting maangte hain — 10 se 12 ghante. Wajah lipid profile aur fasting sugar hain. Isliye subah 6 se 8 ka pehla slot lijiye, raat ka khana 9 baje tak kar lijiye, beech me sirf saada paani, aur naashta taiyaar rakhiye. 14 ghante se zyada bhookhe rehna faayda nahi, nuksan karta hai.

faqs.question: Main gaon me rehta hoon, Salempur kasbe me nahi — package ghar par ho jaayega?
faqs.answer: Haan. Sample Salempur kasbe ke saath Bhatni, Lar, Bhatpar Rani, Bhagalpur, Majhauli Raj, Rampur Karkhana aur Barhaj tak liya jaata hai, aur in kasbon se lage gaon bhi aam taur par cover hote hain. Aapke gaon ka naam is soochi me na ho to maan kar mat baithiye ki service nahi hai — ek call kar lijiye, cover hota hai to usi call par slot book ho jaayega. Pata likhte waqt tola ya purwa ka naam aur ek jaana-pehchana landmark zaroor daaliye — school, mandir, block office ya chauraha — kyunki yahan makan number se zyada kaam landmark aata hai.

faqs.question: Zyada parameter wala package hamesha behtar hota hai?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Ginti apne aap me kuch nahi batati — ek package 80 parameter de sakta hai jisme thyroid ho hi na, aur wo 45 parameter wale se kamzor hoga. Do package milaate waqt dono ki list saamne rakhiye aur dekhiye ki CBC, sugar, lipid, liver, kidney, thyroid aur vitamin me se kya-kya hai. Jo chhoot gaya, uska pata agle saal chalta hai.

faqs.question: Ghar ke chaar log ek saath full body checkup kara sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Haan, aur yahi sabse aasan tareeka hai. Sabki booking ek hi slot me kar dijiye — ek hi visit me sabka sample ho jaata hai. Har vyakti ka naam, umar aur package alag likhwaiye. Jinke test me fasting nahi lagti unhe bhookha rakhne ki zaroorat nahi. Report har vyakti ki alag PDF me aati hai.

faqs.question: Full body checkup se cancer ya dil ki bimari pakad me aa jaati hai?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Package screening hai — wo un cheezon ko jaldi pakadta hai jo blood aur urine me dikhti hain: sugar, cholesterol, thyroid, liver, kidney aur vitamin ki kami. Cancer ki screening, dil ki jaanch, aur X-ray ya ultrasound par dikhne wali cheezein isme nahi aatin, aur wo hamari service me bhi shaamil nahi hain. Koi shikayat ho to doctor ko dikhaiye.

faqs.question: Package saal me kitni baar karana chahiye?
faqs.answer: Umar 30 se kam aur koi shikayat nahi — do saal me ek baar kaafi hai. 30 ke upar saal me ek baar, aur har baar lagbhag usi mahine me, taaki tulna seedhi rahe. Ek-do mahine me dobara karana bekaar hai; number itni jaldi badalte nahi. Sugar, BP ya thyroid ki dawa chal rahi ho to follow-up alag chalta hai — use package se mat badaliye.

faqs.question: Periods ke dinon me full body checkup kara sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Blood ke test par iska koi khaas asar nahi padta, lekin urine ka sample un dinon saaf nahi aata. Package me urine routine shaamil hota hai, isliye do-teen din baad ka slot lena behtar hai. Rukna theek na lagta ho to booking ke waqt bata dijiye — us hisaab se tay kar liya jaayega.

faqs.question: Full body checkup me kaun se test hote hain?
faqs.answer: Ek aam package me CBC, fasting blood sugar, HbA1c, lipid profile, LFT (liver), KFT (kidney), thyroid (TSH) aur urine routine aate hain; advanced package me Vitamin D, Vitamin B12 aur urine microalbumin bhi jud jaate hain. Har lab ka package bilkul yahi list de, ye zaroori nahi — isliye booking se pehle TEST ki poori soochi maangiye, parameter ki ginti nahi. Us soochi me paanch hisse dhoondhiye: khoon, sugar, dil (lipid), liver aur kidney. Ye paanch poore hain to package kaam ka hai; ek bhi chhoot raha hai to wo adhoora hai, chahe parameter kitne bhi likhe hon.

faqs.question: Kis umar me full body checkup shuru karna chahiye?
faqs.answer: Bina kisi shikayat ke bhi 30 ke baad saal me ek baar aam salah hai. 30 se kam umar me bhi ek baar baseline nikaalna kaam aata hai — taaki aage tulna ke liye ek report maujood rahe. Ghar me diabetes, BP ya dil ki bimari chali aa rahi ho to apni umar se ek level upar wala package lijiye, aur us case me 25 ke aas-paas hi shuruaat theek rehti hai. 45 ke baad urine microalbumin zaroor jodiye.

faqs.question: Full body checkup ki report kitne din me aa jaati hai?
faqs.answer: Package ke saare aam test — CBC, sugar, HbA1c, lipid, LFT, KFT, thyroid aur urine routine — 24 ghante ke andar PDF me phone par aa jaate hain, aur Vitamin D tatha B12 bhi utne hi samay me. Ek hi cheez is niyam se bahar hai: urine culture, jismein 48 se 72 ghante lagte hain kyunki organism ko pehle ugana padta hai. Isliye chutti me ghar aaye hain to sample chutti khatam hone se kam se kam do din pehle de dijiye — report haath me le kar jaana hi asli faayda hai.

faqs.question: Salempur me ghar par hi sample de kar package karaya ja sakta hai?
faqs.answer: Haan, poora package ghar par ho jaata hai aur home collection ka koi alag charge nahi judta — kasba ya gaon hone ki wajah se bhi nahi. Slot subah 6 baje se shuru hote hain, jo fasting wale package ke liye sabse theek rehta hai. Phlebotomist ID card ke saath aata hai. Payment sample lene ke waqt cash ya UPI se hota hai, pehle se kuch nahi dena hota.
